activity_average_per_person_day.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip Cape Town travel-cost page; travel cost data last updated May 21, 2026
activity_average_per_person_day.sourceTitle: Cape Town Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to Cape Town: Food & Meal Budget, Daily & Weekly Expenses | BudgetYourTrip.com
activity_average_per_person_day.evidenceText: Sightseeing activities, entertainment, and entrance tickets in Cape Town typically cost an average of $26 (R427) per person, per day based on the spending of previous travelers. This includes fees paid for admission tickets to museums and attractions, day tours, and other sightseeing expenses.
activity_average_per_person_day.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Cape Town South Africa travel cost sightseeing activities entertainment entrance tickets per person per day
activity_average_per_person_day.reason: Accepted as an exact Cape Town activity/entertainment city statistic with explicit per-person-per-day basis. No multiplication or mapping to the two-traveller product value was performed.
